plugins.name: balance-dashboard
plugins.description: Left-sidebar balance widget for DeepSeek, Volcengine (account + Coding Plan) and ZCode, with a settings modal and consumption analytics (time/project/task filters, charts). Injected via app.asar; requires a restart.

description_i18n.zh-CN: 左侧边栏余额：DeepSeek、火山引擎账户与 Coding Plan、ZCode 套餐与今日消耗。点击余额行查看多维度消耗分析，齿轮配置密钥。组件通过 app.asar 注入，安装/更新后需重启 ZCode。
